name: @wintent/plugin-fitness-actions
description: Action catalog for the fitness-trainer vertical pack — preloads ~55 common Chinese exercises with category, muscle groups, typical sets/reps, equipment. Powers the I10-T10 LiveSession card's planning step (action picker) + the LLM's query_actions tool.
description.zh-CN: 健身教练 vertical pack 的动作底座 — 预置约 55 个常见动作（部位 / 主参与肌群 / 推荐组数次数 / 器械）。支撑 I10-T10 实时训练卡片的计划步骤（动作选择器）+ LLM 的 query_actions 工具。
